name: Mandarin tuition
summary: How expat families arrange Mandarin tuition in Singapore — mother-tongue school support, adult beginner pathways, online vs centre formats, and realistic fluency goals.
body:
Mandarin demand spans international-school mother-tongue support, bilingual primary homework, and adult beginners who need workplace basics. Centres, private tutors, and online platforms all compete — match format to exam pressure vs conversation goals.

## Formats
- 1:1 home or centre tuition
- Small group enrichment classes
- Adult beginner evening cohorts
- Exam-focused composition / oral drills
- Online lessons across time zones for trailing families

Clarify simplified vs traditional script expectations early.

## How to choose
Prefer tutors who diagnose listening, speaking, reading, and writing separately. Ask for a 4-week trial plan with measurable targets. Confirm homework load so it does not crush other subjects.

## Practical tip
Record a 1-minute baseline oral clip before week one. Progress arguments get clearer when you can replay month-old tones.
